FBH-01-002-b.id: Hampir! Di cerita, perubahan datang dari usul seorang anak. {model}
FBH-01-002-b.en: Almost! In the story, the change came from a child's idea. {model}

FBH-01-002-c.id: Hampir! Justru usulnya didengar setelah semua bergiliran. {model}
FBH-01-002-c.en: Almost! Actually, their idea was heard once everyone took turns. {model}

FBH-01-004-b.id: Hampir! Kalimat kasar bisa membuat orang marah, bukan pindah. {model}
FBH-01-004-b.en: Almost! Harsh words can make people angry instead of moving. {model}

FBH-01-004-c.id: Hampir! Masalahnya tidak selesai, dan bisa jadi gosip. {model}
FBH-01-004-c.en: Almost! The problem isn't solved, and it can turn into gossip. {model}

FBH-01-007-left_out.id: Hampir! Mengucilkan teman yang berbeda membuatnya merasa tidak diterima. {model}
FBH-01-007-left_out.en: Almost! Shutting out someone different makes them feel unwelcome. {model}

FBH-01-007-phone_unkind.id: Hampir! Pesan yang mengejek menyakiti, juga di dunia maya. {model}
FBH-01-007-phone_unkind.en: Almost! Mocking messages hurt, online too. {model}

FBH-01-008-b.id: Hampir! Itu membuat puasanya lebih berat. Menghormati artinya tidak menggoda. {model}
FBH-01-008-b.en: Almost! That makes fasting harder. Respect means no teasing. {model}

FBH-01-008-c.id: Hampir! Ia tidak meminta itu. Toleransi berarti saling menghormati, bukan memaksa. {model}
FBH-01-008-c.en: Almost! They didn't ask for that. Tolerance means respecting each other, not forcing. {model}

FBH-01-011-interrupt.id: Hampir! Memotong membuat dialog berhenti. Dialog butuh bergiliran mendengar. {model}
FBH-01-011-interrupt.en: Almost! Cutting in stops a dialogue. Dialogue needs turns at listening. {model}

FBH-01-011-phone_unkind.id: Hampir! Pesan yang mengejek bukan dialog. Dialog saling menghormati. {model}
FBH-01-011-phone_unkind.en: Almost! A mocking message isn't dialogue. Dialogue is respectful. {model}

FBH-01-013-b.id: Hampir! Kalau semua berteriak, tidak ada yang didengar. {model}
FBH-01-013-b.en: Almost! If everyone shouts, no one is heard. {model}

FBH-01-013-c.id: Hampir! Pendapatmu penting. Kamu boleh meminta giliran dengan sopan. {model}
FBH-01-013-c.en: Almost! Your view matters. You can politely ask for your turn. {model}

FBH-01-014-b.id: Hampir! Cara berdoa penting bagi setiap orang. Menertawakannya menyakitkan. {model}
FBH-01-014-b.en: Almost! The way someone prays matters to them. Laughing at it hurts. {model}

FBH-01-014-c.id: Hampir! Toleransi berarti membiarkan setiap orang dengan caranya. {model}
FBH-01-014-c.en: Almost! Tolerance means letting everyone keep their own way. {model}

FBH-02-001-b.id: Hampir! Makanan yang dibuang sia-sia. Ada petani dan juru masak yang bekerja keras. {model}
FBH-02-001-b.en: Almost! Wasted food is a shame. Farmers and cooks worked hard for it. {model}

FBH-02-001-c.id: Hampir! Tubuhmu butuh makan. Sederhana bukan berarti tidak makan. {model}
FBH-02-001-c.en: Almost! Your body needs food. Living simply doesn't mean not eating. {model}

FBH-02-008-b.id: Hampir! Lucu bagi satu orang bisa menyakitkan bagi yang lain. {model}
FBH-02-008-b.en: Almost! Funny for one person can hurt another. {model}

FBH-02-008-c.id: Hampir! Jumlah balasan tidak penting. Perasaan temanmu yang penting. {model}
FBH-02-008-c.en: Almost! The number of replies doesn't matter. Your friend's feelings do. {model}

FBH-02-009-phone_unkind.id: Hampir! Itu pesan di awal cerita. Di akhir, ia mengirim pesan dukungan. {model}
FBH-02-009-phone_unkind.en: Almost! That was at the start. At the end, they sent a supportive message. {model}

FBH-02-011-b.id: Hampir! Kalau ternyata salah, banyak orang ikut tertipu. {model}
FBH-02-011-b.en: Almost! If it's false, lots of people get fooled. {model}

FBH-02-011-c.id: Hampir! Banyak yang membagikan belum tentu benar. {model}
FBH-02-011-c.en: Almost! Lots of shares doesn't make it true. {model}

FBH-02-013-b.id: Hampir! Sepatumu masih bagus. Barang baru tidak selalu membuat lebih bahagia. {model}
FBH-02-013-b.en: Almost! Your shoes are still good. New things don't always make us happier. {model}

FBH-02-013-c.id: Hampir! Itu membuang barang yang masih berguna, dan tidak jujur. {model}
FBH-02-013-c.en: Almost! That wastes something useful, and it isn't honest. {model}

FBH-02-014-b.id: Hampir! Orang yang ramah di internet belum tentu orang baik. Alamat itu rahasia. {model}
FBH-02-014-b.en: Almost! Friendly online doesn't always mean safe. Your address is private. {model}

FBH-02-014-c.id: Hampir! Sebagian alamat pun bisa dipakai untuk menemukanmu. {model}
FBH-02-014-c.en: Almost! Even part of an address can be used to find you. {model}

body.id: Berani bicara artinya menyampaikan pendapat atau membela yang benar, dengan kata-kata yang santun.
body.en: Speaking up means sharing your view or standing up for what's right, with polite words.

body.id: Toleransi artinya menghormati keyakinan dan cara hidup orang lain, walau berbeda dengan kita.
body.en: Tolerance means respecting other people's beliefs and ways of life, even when they differ from ours.

body.id: Dialog: dengarkan dulu, tanyakan, lalu sampaikan pendapatmu dengan tenang.
body.en: Dialogue: listen first, ask questions, then share your view calmly.

body.id: Bersyukur artinya menyadari hal baik yang sudah kita punya: keluarga, teman, makanan, kesehatan.
body.en: Gratitude means noticing the good things we already have: family, friends, food, health.

body.id: Hidup sederhana artinya memakai secukupnya dan tidak harus memiliki semua yang dimiliki orang lain.
body.en: Living simply means using what we need, without having to own everything others have.

body.id: Di internet, bersikaplah seperti di dunia nyata: santun, jujur, dan menjaga data pribadi.
body.en: Online, act as you would offline: be polite, be honest and keep personal details private.

ST-NIL-K-X-SUARA.figure: Aya dan teman-teman (tokoh rekaan / fictional characters)
ST-NIL-K-X-SUARA.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Kelas sedang memilih tempat karyawisata. Semua boleh menyampaikan usul.
caption.en: The class is choosing a place for a field trip. Everyone may suggest one.

caption.id: Beberapa anak bicara bersamaan dan memotong usul temannya.
caption.en: Some children talk at once and cut in on a classmate's idea.

caption.id: Seorang anak mengangkat tangan dan berkata sopan, "Boleh kita bergiliran supaya semua terdengar?"
caption.en: One child raises a hand and says politely, "Can we take turns so everyone is heard?"

caption.id: Kini semua bergiliran. Usul teman yang pendiam ternyata bagus: kebun raya!
caption.en: Now everyone takes turns. The quiet classmate's idea turns out great: the botanical garden!

caption.id: Mereka memilih bersama. Berani bicara dengan santun membuat semua suara didengar.
caption.en: They decide together. Speaking up politely lets every voice be heard.

ST-NIL-K-X-PESAN.figure: Aya dan teman-teman (tokoh rekaan / fictional characters)

title.en: A message in the class group

ST-NIL-K-X-PESAN.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Di grup kelas, ada yang mengirim foto teman sambil mengejek.
caption.en: In the class group chat, someone posts a classmate's photo with a mean joke.

caption.id: Teman di foto itu merasa malu dan sedih.
caption.en: The classmate in the photo feels embarrassed and sad.

caption.id: Seorang anak berhenti sejenak sebelum membalas. "Kalau aku di posisinya, bagaimana rasanya?"
caption.en: One child pauses before replying. "How would I feel in their place?"

caption.id: Ia menulis, "Yuk, hapus fotonya, kasihan dia." Lalu ia mengirim pesan dukungan kepada temannya.
caption.en: They write, "Let's delete the photo, it's not kind." Then they send their friend a supportive message.

caption.id: Esoknya, mereka bermain bersama lagi. Satu pesan baik bisa mengubah hari seseorang.
caption.en: The next day, they play together again. One kind message can change someone's day.

model_answer.id: Berani bicara dengan santun membuat semua suara didengar.
model_answer.en: Speaking up politely lets every voice be heard.

meaning.id: Apa yang membuat rapat itu berubah?
meaning.en: What changed the meeting?

text.id: Ada yang berani mengusulkan bergiliran dengan sopan

model_answer.id: Satu anak berani mengusulkan bergiliran dengan sopan, dan semua suara akhirnya terdengar.
model_answer.en: One child bravely and politely suggested turns, and every voice was finally heard.

meaning.id: Di cerita, usul terbaik datang dari anak yang suaranya paling keras.
meaning.en: In the story, the best idea came from the loudest child.

model_answer.id: Usul yang bagus datang dari teman yang pendiam, setelah semua bergiliran.
model_answer.en: The good idea came from a quiet classmate, once everyone took turns.

meaning.id: Ada yang menyerobot antrean di depanmu.
meaning.en: Someone pushes in right in front of you.

text.id: "Maaf, antreannya mulai dari belakang sana, ya."
text.en: "Excuse me, the queue starts back there."
"Hey, who do you think you are?"
Stay quiet, then grumble to a friend

model_answer.id: Bicara dengan tegas tapi sopan. Kalimat yang santun lebih mudah didengar.
model_answer.en: Speak firmly but politely. Polite words are easier to hear.

meaning.id: Kalimat mana yang santun?
meaning.en: Which sentences are polite?

model_answer.id: Santun: menyampaikan pendapat, meminta giliran, dan tidak setuju sambil memberi alasan. "Idemu jelek" dan "Diam kamu" menyerang orangnya, bukan membahas idenya.
model_answer.en: Polite: giving your view, asking for your turn and disagreeing with a reason. "Your idea is rubbish" and "Shut up" attack the person, not the idea.

meaning.id: Membela teman yang diejek.
meaning.en: Standing up for a friend who's teased.

text.en: Walk away together with your friend

text.id: Ceritakan kepada guru atau orang dewasa
text.en: Tell a teacher or another adult

text.id: Bilang tegas dan sopan, "Tolong berhenti, itu menyakitkan."
text.en: Say firmly and politely, "Please stop, that hurts."

model_answer.id: Tenangkan diri, minta berhenti dengan tegas dan sopan, ajak temanmu menjauh, lalu ceritakan kepada orang dewasa.
model_answer.en: Stay calm, ask them firmly and politely to stop, walk away together, then tell an adult.

meaning.id: Mana yang menunjukkan toleransi?
meaning.en: Which one shows tolerance?

model_answer.id: Bermain dan bekerja bersama walau berbeda: itulah toleransi.
model_answer.en: Playing and working together despite differences: that's tolerance.

meaning.id: Temanmu sedang berpuasa. Kalian makan siang di kelas.
meaning.en: Your friend is fasting. Everyone else is eating lunch in class.

text.id: Melarang semua teman makan di kelas
text.en: Ban everyone from eating in class

text.id: Makan dengan sopan, tanpa pamer atau menggodanya
text.en: Eat politely, without flaunting or teasing

model_answer.id: Makan dengan sopan, tanpa pamer dan tanpa menggoda. Toleransi berjalan dua arah: saling menghormati.
model_answer.en: Eat politely, without flaunting your food or teasing. Tolerance works both ways: mutual respect.

meaning.id: Kalimat yang pas untuk berdialog.
meaning.en: The right words for a dialogue.

text.en: When you want to add something

model_answer.id: Dialog yang baik: memberi alasan saat tidak setuju, bertanya saat belum paham, berterima kasih, dan meminta giliran.
model_answer.en: Good dialogue: give reasons when you disagree, ask when you don't understand, say thanks and ask for a turn.

meaning.id: Mendengarkan pendapat yang berbeda berarti kita harus setuju.
meaning.en: Listening to a different opinion means we have to agree with it.

model_answer.id: Kita bisa mendengarkan dan menghormati, lalu tetap punya pendapat sendiri.
model_answer.en: We can listen and be respectful, and still keep our own view.

meaning.id: Mana contoh dialog yang baik?
meaning.en: Which one shows good dialogue?

model_answer.id: Saling mendengarkan bergantian: itulah awal dialog.
model_answer.en: Taking turns to listen: that's how dialogue starts.

model_answer.id: Wawancarai satu teman atau tetangga yang kebiasaannya berbeda denganmu. Ajukan tiga pertanyaan dengan sopan, lalu ceritakan apa yang kamu pelajari.
model_answer.en: Interview a friend or neighbour whose customs differ from yours. Ask three polite questions, then share what you learned.

meaning.id: Kamu belum selesai bicara, tapi temanmu memotong.
meaning.en: You haven't finished, but a friend cuts in.

text.id: "Boleh aku selesaikan dulu? Setelah itu giliranmu."
text.en: "May I finish first? Then it's your turn."

text.id: Diam dan tidak mau bicara lagi
text.en: Go quiet and refuse to talk again

model_answer.id: Minta giliran dengan sopan dan janjikan giliran untuknya juga.
model_answer.en: Ask politely for your turn and promise them theirs.

meaning.id: Sebelum makan, teman-temanmu berdoa dengan cara berbeda-beda.
meaning.en: Before eating, your friends pray in different ways.

text.id: Menunggu dengan tenang sampai semua selesai
text.en: Wait quietly until everyone is done
Ask everyone to do it my way

model_answer.id: Menunggu dengan tenang. Setiap orang boleh berdoa dengan caranya, dan kita saling menghormati.
model_answer.en: Wait quietly. Everyone may pray in their own way, and we respect each other.

items.source: Undang-Undang RI No. 24 Tahun 2009 tentang Bendera, Bahasa, dan Lambang Negara, serta Lagu Kebangsaan, Pasal 46; Soewito Santoso, Sutasoma: A Study in Javanese Wajrayana (New Delhi: International Academy of Indian Culture, 1975).

model_answer.id: Semboyan "Bhinneka Tunggal Ika" berasal dari kitab Sutasoma karya Mpu Tantular, yang ditulis sekitar abad ke-14 pada masa Majapahit. Kini semboyan itu tertulis pada pita yang dicengkeram Garuda Pancasila.
model_answer.en: The motto "Bhinneka Tunggal Ika" (unity in diversity) comes from the Sutasoma, a poem by Mpu Tantular written around the 14th century in the Majapahit era. Today it is written on the ribbon held by the Garuda Pancasila.

meaning.id: Di acara makan bersama, ada banyak lauk.
meaning.en: At a shared meal, there's lots of food.

text.en: Take as much as possible, throw the rest away

text.id: Ambil secukupnya, tambah kalau masih lapar
text.en: Take enough, have more if still hungry

model_answer.id: Ambil secukupnya, dan tambah kalau masih lapar. Begitulah menghargai makanan.
model_answer.en: Take what you need, and more if you're still hungry. That's how we value food.

meaning.id: Bersyukur atau lupa bersyukur?
meaning.en: Grateful, or forgetting to be?

text.id: Mengeluh karena lauknya tidak sesuai selera
text.en: Complaining the food isn't to your taste
Caring for old shoes so they last

text.id: Merengek minta mainan baru setiap hari
text.en: Whining for a new toy every day

model_answer.id: Bersyukur: berterima kasih, merawat barang, menghemat air. Mengeluh dan merengek minta barang baru membuat kita lupa pada yang sudah kita punya.
model_answer.en: Grateful: saying thanks, caring for things, saving water. Complaining and whining for new things make us forget what we already have.

meaning.id: Membuat jurnal syukur.
meaning.en: Keeping a gratitude journal.

text.id: Setiap malam, tulis tiga hal baik hari itu
text.en: Each night, write three good things from the day
After a week, read them all again

model_answer.id: Siapkan buku, tulis tiga hal baik setiap malam, lalu baca lagi setelah seminggu.
model_answer.en: Get a notebook, write three good things each night, then read them again after a week.

meaning.id: Untuk bisa bersyukur, kita harus punya banyak barang.
meaning.en: To feel grateful, we need to own lots of things.

model_answer.id: Rasa syukur datang dari menyadari hal baik, sekecil apa pun: senyum teman, makan bersama, atau hari cerah.
model_answer.en: Gratitude comes from noticing good things, however small: a friend's smile, a shared meal, a sunny day.

meaning.id: Siapa yang bekerja untuk kita?
meaning.en: Who works for us?

model_answer.id: Nasi dari petani, ikan dari nelayan, bus dikemudikan sopir, sup dimasak juru masak. Banyak orang bekerja untuk kita setiap hari.
model_answer.en: Rice from farmers, fish from fishers, the bus driven by a driver, soup made by a cook. Many people work for us every day.

model_answer.id: Buat kartu terima kasih untuk seseorang yang jarang mendapat ucapan terima kasih, misalnya petugas kebersihan atau satpam sekolah.
model_answer.en: Make a thank-you card for someone who rarely gets thanked, like the school cleaner or security guard.

model_answer.id: Satu pesan baik bisa mengubah hari seseorang.
model_answer.en: One kind message can change someone's day.

meaning.id: Apa yang dipikirkan anak itu sebelum membalas?
meaning.en: What did the child think about before replying?

text.en: How to make my reply the funniest

text.id: Bagaimana rasanya kalau aku di posisi temanku
text.en: How I'd feel in my friend's place

model_answer.id: Ia membayangkan perasaan temannya. Berpikir sebelum mengirim membuat kita lebih bijak.
model_answer.en: They imagined how their friend felt. Thinking before sending makes us wiser.

meaning.id: Pesan mana yang dikirim di akhir cerita?
meaning.en: Which message was sent at the end?

model_answer.id: Pesan dukungan untuk temannya, dan ajakan menghapus foto itu.
model_answer.en: A supportive message to their friend, and asking for the photo to be deleted.

meaning.id: Boleh dibagikan di internet?
meaning.en: OK to share online?

text.en: A drawing of your cute cat

model_answer.id: Boleh: hobi dan gambar kucingmu. Rahasiakan: alamat, kata sandi, dan nama sekolah, supaya orang asing tidak bisa menemukanmu.
model_answer.en: OK: your hobby and a drawing of your cat. Keep private: your address, password and school name, so strangers can't find you.

meaning.id: Di grup ada kabar heboh: "Besok sekolah libur!"
meaning.en: A big rumour in the group: "No school tomorrow!"

text.en: Forward it to every group right away

text.id: Cek dulu ke guru sebelum menyebarkan
text.en: Check with a teacher before passing it on

text.id: Percaya saja karena banyak yang membagikan
text.en: Believe it because many people shared it

model_answer.id: Cek dulu ke guru atau pengumuman resmi sekolah. Kabar yang belum pasti jangan disebarkan.
model_answer.en: Check with a teacher or the school's official notice first. Don't pass on news that isn't confirmed.

meaning.id: Kalau ada pesan yang membuatmu takut atau tidak nyaman, ceritakan kepada orang dewasa yang kamu percaya.
meaning.en: If a message makes you scared or uncomfortable, tell an adult you trust.

model_answer.id: Kamu tidak perlu menghadapinya sendirian. Jangan membalas, simpan buktinya, dan ceritakan.
model_answer.en: You don't have to deal with it alone. Don't reply, keep the proof and tell someone.

meaning.id: Sepatumu masih bagus, tapi teman-teman punya model baru.
meaning.en: Your shoes are still fine, but friends have a new style.

text.en: Keep wearing and caring for my shoes

text.id: Merengek minta yang baru sekarang juga
text.en: Whine for new ones right now
Ruin the old ones to get new ones

model_answer.id: Pakai dan rawat sepatumu. Bersyukur atas yang ada membuat hati lebih tenang.
model_answer.en: Wear and care for your shoes. Being grateful for what you have brings peace of mind.

meaning.id: Orang tak dikenal di gim daring menanyakan alamatmu.
meaning.en: A stranger in an online game asks for your address.

text.en: Tell them just the street name

text.id: Tidak memberi tahu, lalu cerita ke orang tua
text.en: Keep it private and tell my parents

model_answer.id: Jangan beri tahu, dan ceritakan kepada orang tua atau guru. Data pribadi harus dijaga.
model_answer.en: Don't share it, and tell a parent or teacher. Personal details must stay private.

meaning.id: Aku rahasia kecil yang menjaga akunmu. Jangan berikan aku kepada siapa pun selain orang tuamu. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: I'm a little secret that guards your account. Don't give me to anyone except your parents. What am I?

model_answer.id: Kata sandi! Simpan baik-baik.
model_answer.en: A password! Keep it safe.
